method: Deterministic JSX view evaluator with stubbed hooks, effects disabled, actions forbidden. Tests execute named UI callbacks only; not React runtime, persistence, hydration or E2E.

tests.name: Document library keeps every store distinct even with matching IDs
Document type filters expose correct specialised records
Name search finds existing saved name without renaming
New document chooser distinguishes branding from structure and supports Back
Partial load error is not described as empty success
Message library distinguishes actual General purpose without fictional invoice/all enums
Failed attachment load prevents destructive accidental edit
New email uses General and switching purpose preserves user-written text
Existing email names, empty subject and body do not get silently replaced
Mobile returns use deterministic parents, preserve guarded workspace ownership
Plan labels use supplied cents, not hardcoded subscription amounts
